name: Rolanda Hollis

items.text: Hollis was arrested Sept. 22, 2019, at a Destin, Florida hotel on a misdemeanor battery charge. A witness told police she shoved a male family member. Hollis and the man denied any altercation, though she admitted throwing a glass. She was released the next morning on a signature bond. No court outcome was found.
items.why: The arrest is documented, but there is no finding or conviction and it doesn't clearly bear on any criterion, such as abuse of office or self-dealing.
Filing a bill the owner may dislike, which Hollis described as a response to the abortion ban, is a legislative stance and not misconduct, and the pro-life platform score already covers it.

for_review: 1) I found no court disposition for the 2019 Okaloosa County, Florida battery case. A check of the Okaloosa clerk of court docket would settle whether it was dropped, diverted or tried. 2) I could not open the Northwest Florida Daily News or AL.com originals, because the fetch tool rejected those links. The facts in item 1 come from the Alabama Political Reporter article, which cites the Daily News and sheriff's records. 3) Wikipedia names the husband and the other reports don't, so I left his name out. 4) Searching for Hollis alongside alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org and infowars.com turned up nothing about her. I did not search each site separately. 5) I did not look into her finances, real estate work, foreign ties, or other controversies, because of the search limit. Her bio notes she is a real estate broker with an accounting degree, which could be checked for criterion 4.
